sentences.text: Let's keep this short. Where are we on the ingest rewrite?
Branch is up. Two reviewers already looked at it. I want to get it merged by end of week.
Any blockers?
Only the migration ordering, and I think I've got that sorted.
We might want to refactor the whole connector layer at some point, it's getting unwieldy.
Noted, but not this sprint. Tomasz, the staging deploy has been failing since Thursday. Is anyone actually looking at that?
I could take a look at it sometime this week if nobody else is on it.
That's not really an answer. Can you own it?
Fine, yes. I'll fix the staging deploy and have it green first thing Monday.
Thank you. Elena, the rate-limit thing you mentioned last week?
Still on my list. Assuming the vendor gets us the sandbox key, I'll ship the retry logic on Thursday.
And if they don't?
Then it slips. But I'll chase them either way.
The error rates on the webhook endpoint have doubled this month, by the way.
Doubled from what to what?
From about point one percent to point two. So still tiny, just worth watching.
Okay. Someone should write up the incident from last Tuesday at some point, soon ideally.
I'll do the write-up.
When?
Honestly, when I get a chance. It's not urgent.
Fair. That's everything from me.
